column1: # ShedOS proprietary app catalog — installed on demand via shedos-apps-installer.
# These are AUR packages whose licenses forbid redistribution through
# repo.shedos.org, so they are NOT shipped in the default install. The
# installer surfaces them as an opt-in checklist on first boot and can be
# re-opened at any time from the app launcher.
# Categories are grouped verbatim in the picker UI — keep them short.
# Icon column is a Freedesktop icon name; fallback is "package-x-generic".

column4: Microsoft's cross-platform code editor with IntelliSense and the full marketplace.
